teacher_info.introduction:
I am a native English speaker from the United States. After obtaining my certification in TEFL, I moved to China, where I spent one year teaching English to students ages 4 to adult. Since then, I have moved back to the USA and have gained six years of experience as a teacher, a private tutor, and an academic advisor for both foreign students and American students. My lessons focus on pronunciation (the ultimate goal being a native English accent) and conversation. With pronunciation, you will learn in a different way than you might expect. I teach muscle memory, speed, and tonality. (Remember the goal is to speak like a native!) Everyone learns grammar from a school, but how can we learn to have a casual conversation? By talking, of course! With conversation practice, you will be given prompts to answer as quickly and naturally as you can. Or you can simply choose to have a casual conversation! Every lesson can be customized for each student's needs and interests. Do you have a particular hobby or topic you enjoy? Is there one part of English that you struggle with more than others? Ask me to make a custom lesson just for you! Children's lessons will be chosen according to their skill level and what the parents would like. All children's lessons will include pictures (and maybe a few short videos and songs) to help them understand.

This is a consultation for students to see what their strengths and weaknesses are and what things they need to work on to improve their English language skills. 

      This lesson gives students the opportunity to get feedback and a road map on what they need to improve and how to go about it. 

Lesson Outline:
1.	Assessment: The teacher will start the lesson by assessing the student's current level of English and identifying the areas where they need to improve.
2.	Goal Setting: The teacher and the student will discuss the student's language learning goals, and together, they will set specific, achievable goals for further lessons.
3.	Planning: We will produce a comprehensive learning plan focused on your particular needs.

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar Lesson
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed to meet the specific needs and goals of the student. It will provide a tailored approach to improving the student's grammar skills and help them achieve their language learning objectives.

Objective:

The objective of this customized grammar lesson is to provide the student with help in the areas of grammar that they need to improve their English-speaking skills. The lesson will be completely focused on the student's specific need(s).

Materials:

The materials used in this lesson are from my own specialized curriculum made by myself and will be tailored to the student's level and learning goals. This will include worksheets, some handouts, and other language materials such as articles, videos, and audio recordings. 

Lesson Outline:

1.	Topic Explanation: I will provide a clear and concise explanation of the specific area of grammar that the student requested. I will use real-life examples and provide relevant context to ensure that the student grasps the concepts fully.
2.	Practice: I will provide the student with a range of exercises to practice applying the grammar rules and structures. These may include fill-in-the-blank exercises, sentence construction exercises, and role-playing activities.
3.	Feedback and Correction: I will provide the student with feedback on their performance and correct any errors that they make. I will also provide guidance on how to improve and offer additional practice opportunities as needed.


At the end of the lesson, the teacher and the student will review the progress made, discuss any areas that need further attention, and set goals for future lessons.

pro_course_detail.title: Free Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
The Free Conversation lesson is an informal and relaxed lesson designed to help you practice your English conversational skills. This program is ideal for those who want to improve their confidence in speaking English and practice using the language in a natural setting.

Objectives:

The objectives of this lesson are to provide you with opportunities to practice your conversational skills, increase your fluency, gain confidence in speaking, and improve your listening skills.

Program Outline:

The lesson is informal and flexible, and there is no specific outline or structure. The program allows for free-flowing conversation and can cover a range of topics and themes picked specifically by the student. The program's approach is student-led, and the teacher will facilitate the conversation based on the student's interests and preferences.
Each session of the Free Conversation Program allows for the student to have an opportunity to speak while also receiving feedback and correction from the teacher. The program's informal and relaxed nature allows for the student to feel comfortable and confident while speaking.

By participating in this lesson, you will have opportunities to practice your conversational skills, gain confidence in speaking, and improve your listening skills. The program is designed to be flexible and adaptable, allowing for a range of topics and themes to be explored during the conversation while making the student feel relaxed, comfortable, and confident while speaking.

teacher_info.teaching_style: My teaching style is warm, patient, and encouraging. I create a fun, relaxed environment where you can practice without feeling embarrassed. We'll laugh together while practicing conversation on topics that interest you. You'll develop independent learning skills through enjoyable activities that help you continue improving long after our lessons. I'm all about helping you transform unclear speech to first-time clarity through techniques you can apply immediately - making the learning process both effective and fun!

teaching_experience.description: My teaching journey spans nearly 20 years, beginning with homeschooling my four children where I developed and refined my phonogram-based approach to pronunciation. I've taught over 1,000 ESL students ranging from ages 12 to 70, including professionals, college students, and motivated teenagers. While I've worked with all proficiency levels from beginners to advanced learners, I particularly enjoy teaching lower to upper intermediate students who are eager to improve their pronunciation.

course_info.trial_description: In this 30-minute pronunciation trial lesson, we'll identify your specific pronunciation challenges through a casual conversation about topics that interest you. I'll provide personalized feedback on problematic sounds, rhythm, and intonation patterns while introducing effective techniques to improve your English clarity. pro_course_detail.title: American English All Vowels Clarity
pro_course_detail.description:
Master the complete range of American English vowel sounds in this focused class designed for intermediate learners. Each session explores the full spectrum of IPA vowels and phonograms, helping you develop clear, natural-sounding pronunciation. You'll learn:

* Precise mouth positioning and practical techniques for each vowel sound
* Common pronunciation patterns that will immediately improve your clarity
By the end of this class series, you'll have significantly reduced vowel-related misunderstandings and gained confidence in your everyday English conversations. Personalized feedback throughout ensures you make measurable progress.
